Name: Christmas Holiday Inspired Crops
Author: sakialyn
Description:
It's the holiday season, and what better way to celebrate than some Christmas themed crops! Saplings and seeds can be bought from Pierre's store.

[b][u]Mod details below:[/u][/b]

[b]Candy Cane[/b] - Ready to eat or crush them up to make some holiday treats!
[b]Gingerbread Man[/b] - These holiday treats are mostly known for being difficult to catch.
[b]S'mores[/b] - Harvest chocolate drops and marshmallows to make hot chocolate and other favorites!
[b]Rudolph's Nose[/b] - A berry that is sweet to the taste and emits a warm glow, much like a certain famous reindeer.
[b]Snowmen[/b] - You would expect they would generate icy clumps, but it's actually balls of packed powdered sugar.
[b]Sugar Plum[/b] - Delicious dried fruit rolled in layers of sugar.
[b]Sugar Cookies[/b] - Ever wish you could just plant some cookie crumbs and get more cookies? Now you can!

Recipes for the above can be bought from Gus! Also adds Rum which Gus sells and Chex cereal from Pierre's.

This mod also adds a new machine, a [b]mini Christmas Tree[/b]! Take the below crops here to open them for various surprises!

[b]Present Box[/b] - What wonders await inside??
[b]Nutcracker[/b] - Made famous from a certain ballet, but they're also adept at cracking nuts and other things with tough shells.
[b]Filled Stocking[/b] - The festive ones are usually filled with treats and toys... and sometimes coal.


An IMMENSE shoutout to the SDV Discord modding community whose help was indispensable in getting my ideas to work!

Merry Christmas!
